review: Astra Ultra row-validator four-query EXPLAIN diagnostic plan
approved_design: Disposable real public100-create group setup repeated10 times in one consumer transaction; inspect four original read-only validator SELECTs for first/middle/last actual object using prepared, deliberately forced-generic EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS FORMAT JSON. No production changes, alternate synthetic seeding, indexes, statistics updates, trigger suppression or deadline relaxation. Roll back setup and clean fixture.
required_details: All public setup calls run with original native checks and limits before any extra data-read grant. If any setup call fails, retain exact original outcome/context and stop without synthetic seed, smaller retry or altered deadline.

The four tables are runtime_object_transition, runtime_object_attempt, runtime_catalog_rebind_transition and runtime_catalog_key_backfill. The first two queries also require EXECUTE on private runtime_owned_profile(): grant only that exact immutable constant-returning function to this fixture consumer after setup. Do not grant validator, mutation or broad function permissions; do not substitute a literal for the original function call.

Use the same consumer connection and open original transaction so pg_current_xact_id() and uncommitted transition visibility match setup. No COMMIT, SET ROLE, impersonation or copied transition data. Admin only supplies fixture grants/metadata; rollback and fixture teardown remove all data/grants.

Keep exact FROM/JOIN/WHERE/projection/CASE/UNION/ORDER/LIMIT expressions, including pg_current_xact_id(). Remove only PL/pgSQL loop/INTO syntax and replace local selected_id/selected_type/current_actor references with bigint/int/oid prepared parameters. Retain source slices and final parameterized SQL separately with hashes.

Mirror validator search_path=pg_catalog,pg_temp, row_security=off, TimeZone=UTC and bytea_output=hex, and record effective settings/roles/transaction identity, index definitions, relation statistics and execution order. Preserve10s statement limits. The30s host bound applies to each public setup operation; do not claim it bounds the entire ten-operation transaction or raw diagnostic statements unless actually enforced there.

Use actual returned public identities for first/middle/last and actual current actor OID. Report per-table/per-query actual rows, rows removed, loop counts, buffers and planning/execution outputs; do not presume empty legacy/rebind/backfill branches are missing evidence.

Queries are read-only apart from pg_current_xact_id() observation/allocation, already assigned by real creates. No deferred constraint flush is needed or authorized; rollback deliberately leaves no COMMIT qualification.
interpretation_limits: Ten100-operation attempts yield1000same-XID object transitions but ten attempt rows and100-result receipts, not the one1024-attempt shape. This is targeted diagnostic setup only, never capacity or performance qualification.

force_generic_plan is a controlled planner choice, not evidence that production PL/pgSQL selected a generic plan. No ANALYZE-table or synthetic statistics; retain fresh/unanalysed statistics honestly.

EXPLAIN ANALYZE adds profiling overhead and sees cache effects from ordered setup/probes. Its query time excludes PL/pgSQL record assignment/materialization and subsequent row/key/history/authority checks; it cannot alone attribute the full row-validator self time or a CREATE/UPDATE difference.

Explicit consumer SELECT/constant-function grants reproduce these SQL data accesses only; they do not qualify ordinary consumer authorization. No public API use after grants is claimed as authority evidence.
If any diagnostic statement fails, preserve its complete error/partial artifacts and cleanup result, without claiming plans that were not obtained.
next_step: Author exact extracted-query harness for source comparison before execution; run only in the coordinated released native slot. No new production instrumentation or broadened diagnostic framework.
reviewer_actions: Read-only source and ACL/configuration inspection, then receipt write. No product edits, builds, native runs or agents.
